newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end sharply up as blue-chips revive.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end sharply up as blue-chips revive.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed sharply higher on Thursday, with the key Nikkei average leaping more than 280 points as a rally in shares of global companies was revived, brokers said.
But some sectors were still hit by heavy sales, and overall sentiment was not completely bullish, they said.
The Nikkei 225 average surged 283.99 points or 1.37 percent to finish at 20,943.90. Its December futures closed 290 points higher at 20,940.
"Blue chips such as Toyota tested new highs, and that helped to lift the market," said Akihiro Naemura, strategist at Okasan Securities Co Ltd.
